description: From the public path by the visitor pavilion, the restored concrete Golfbak and its weir sit among trees in the Waterloopbos. Moss and ferns cover the old test channels. It is partly cloudy, about 9.2°C, with wind near 3.2 km/h and cloud cover about 72%. The pavilion is closed. The later artwork at the entrance is not this view.
